No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-p/) **Good afternoon!** We are just under one month away from the 2026 Northern Indiana State Party Dinner, and we would love for you to join us! The dinner will take place on Wednesday, October 28 in Valparaiso.Governor Mike Braun will deliver the keynote, along with U.S. Senator Todd Young, Lt. Governor Micah Beckwith, Attorney General Todd Rokita, Treasurer Daniel Elliott, Comptroller Elise Nieshalla, Secretary of State candidate Max Engling and Chairwoman Lana Keesling. There are individual tickets and tables for 8 available, as well as sponsorship levels with access to the VIP reception. For more information, please [click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-r/).Please reply to this email, email [rsvp@indiana.gop](mailto:rsvp@indiana.gop), or use the links below to RSVP and reserve your seat today![Individual Giving](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-y/) | [Corporate Giving](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-j/)Feel free to reach out to our team with any questions, and we hope to see you there in Valparaiso on October 28!### [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-d/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-h/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-k/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdllltk-hhlljjcji-u/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W.
